subject: printing p-values in the usermodel results

messages.author: 7bd969ada3b8856b
messages.subject: printing p-values in the usermodel results
parts: Hi! I'm trying to see if there's an option to generate p-values for corresponding estimates from the usermodel results (for both standardized and unstandardized). If there isn't a built-in function, could you please let me know how I could generate p-values for each estimate? Thanks!

messages.author: 0b5254eeb9973d7a
messages.subject: Re: printing p-values in the usermodel results
parts:
Hi Younga,
I would recommend doing something along these lines:
2*pnorm(abs(Unstandardized_Estimate/Unstandardized_SE),lower.tail=FALSE)
Cheers,
Elliot
